title: 6 Foods To Avoid For Belly Fat

scenes.text: Six foods you must avoid if you want to lose belly fat.

scenes.title: WHITE BREAD
scenes.text: Number one: white bread. It's made from refined flour and lacks fiber and essential nutrients. Its high glycemic index means blood sugar spikes and more fat storage.

scenes.title: BEER
scenes.text: Number two: beer. Alcohol is full of empty calories, raises your cortisol levels, and makes your body store fat right around your belly.

scenes.title: SUGARY DRINKS
scenes.text: Number three: sugary drinks. Bubble tea and soda are loaded with sugar and empty calories, promoting weight gain and belly fat.

scenes.title: ICE CREAM
scenes.text: Number four: ice cream. The combo of sugar and unhealthy fats makes it a sneaky contributor to belly fat.

scenes.title: POTATO CHIPS
scenes.text: Number five: potato chips. They're highly processed and full of unhealthy fats and salt. A better alternative? Baked chips made from whole potatoes.

scenes.title: REFINED CARBS
scenes.text: Number six: refined carbs, like white rice and rice cakes. They're digested super fast, causing insulin spikes and more fat storage.
